title: BodyToggle
description: A toggle of a body's model (a mesh, or a "Hide X" shape key of a mesh) and whether it is shown (since 1.5), as the renderer sets it.

mesh.description: The mesh's name in the model.

key.description: The shape key, null for the mesh itself.

hides.description: Whether the key at full weight hides the part (it is shown at 0); false for a mesh.

shown.description: Whether the part is shown: its own state, it is seen only while the toggle it is part of is shown.

parent.description: The id of the toggle this one is part of, mesh:<mesh> or key:<mesh>/<key> (as in BodyPart.id), null for none. A shape key toggle is part of the toggle of its mesh unless the user said otherwise: the bodysuit hidden hides its panties, whatever state they are in, and shows them as they were when it is shown again. The renderer applies it; the server keeps each toggle's own state.
